definitions.explanation: The act of returning something that was borrowed or rented to its owner.

examples.japanese: {図書館|としょかん}の{本|ほん}を{返却|へんきゃく}した。
{返却|へんきゃく}{期限|きげん}は{来週|らいしゅう}の{金曜日|きんようび}です。
examples.english: The return deadline is next Friday.

examples.japanese: レンタカーを{返却|へんきゃく}する{場所|ばしょ}はどこですか。
examples.english: Where do I return the rental car?

notes:
COMPOUND: {返|へん} (return) + {却|きゃく} (reject, return)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {返却|へんきゃく}する (to return)
- {返却|へんきゃく}{期限|きげん} (return deadline)
- {返却|へんきゃく}{日|び} (return date)
- {返却|へんきゃく}{口|ぐち} (return slot/counter)
- {本|ほん}の{返却|へんきゃく} (book return)

CONTEXTS:
- Library books
- Rental items (cars, equipment)
- Borrowed money (formal)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {返|かえ}す (to return - verb, more casual)
- {返品|へんぴん} (return of merchandise for refund)
